text: dsh-attention-notify 是面向 DSH Web 的浏览器通知插件。它订阅 DSH 的会话列表状态，在会话完成、等待审批、等待回答、计划待评审，以及后台任务完成、失败或终止时发送系统通知。设置项集成在 DSH 通用设置中，可开启浏览器通知权限并发送测试通知；点击通知会聚焦浏览器并打开对应会话。适合希望在切换标签页或处理其他工作时留意 DSH 会话和后台任务的人。使用时需要浏览器支持并授权通知，DSH 网页需保持打开；代码未配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-attention-notify alerts DSH Web users when sessions finish, need approval or answers, or have plans awaiting review. It also reports finished, failed, or stopped background jobs. Enable browser notifications in General settings. Clicking an alert opens its session; keep the DSH page open.
DSH 会话结束时能不能弹个浏览器通知？
想及时知道有审批或问题等着我处理。
Can I get browser alerts when a DSH background job finishes or fails?
dsh-attention-notify 的功能「会话关注提醒」：订阅 DSH 会话状态，在会话完成、需要审批、等待回答或计划待评审时发送浏览器通知。用户点击通知后，浏览器聚焦并打开对应会话。
dsh-attention-notify 的功能「后台任务通知」：跟踪会话关联的后台任务状态；任务进入完成、失败或终止状态时发出浏览器通知，通知显示任务标签，点击后返回对应会话。

dsh-attention-notify README · dsh-attention-notify：English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Native browser notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The plugin observes the existing DSH session-list feed and notifies for:

- conversation and subtask completion
- approval requests
- questions awaiting an answer
- plans awaiting review
- completed, failed, or killed background jobs

It remains event-driven while the page is hidden; there is no visibility-gated polling. Clicking a notification focuses the browser and opens the matching session.

dsh-attention-notify README · dsh-attention-notify：The first job list for each session establishes a baseline, so opening or reconnecting a session does not replay old job completions. Later terminal transitions, including jobs that finish between snapshots, still notify.

dsh-attention-notify README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Unintendedz/dsh-attention-notify#v0.1.4
```

Restart `dsh web`, refresh the page, then open **Settings → General → Task notifications** and choose **Enable notifications**. A successful permission grant sends one test notification. Already-enabled browsers show a **Send test notification** action. Dismissed or blocked permission requests leave visible site-settings guidance in the same row.

dsh-attention-notify README · Install：The notification control lives in Settings and no longer occupies the sidebar footer. Existing browser permission is preserved; notifications continue while Settings is closed. To turn off browser notifications, change the permission in your browser's site settings.

dsh-attention-notify README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-attention-notify
```

Restart DSH Web after removing the plugin.

dsh-attention-notify README · Privacy and limits：- Zero runtime dependencies. No server, shell execution, external requests, or telemetry.
- Notification text contains the DSH session title or background-job label and may be visible in lock-screen previews.
- The DSH page must remain open. A browser or operating system that suspends or discards the page also suspends a page-only plugin.
- The control uses DSH's native General settings layout. Very narrow windows currently inherit its fixed two-column layout.

dsh-attention-notify README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`npm test` builds the browser bundle before running the built-in Node test runner.
